extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: LED work light on a tripod stand, approx. 78 x 68 x 134 cm (column partly extended), head 30 x 10 x 24 cm
extras.notes: dark steel tripod with rubber feet, spreader struts and telescopic column with clamp knob; U-yoke with two star knobs; yellow LED flood light head with dark front bezel, glowing light panel behind a dark protective grille 'work-lamp_lens_panel' (emissive material, not baked, parented to the head), cooling fins and carry handle: 'work-lamp_head' is a separate object with its origin on the tilt axis through the star knobs (rotate around local X; default pose tilted 10 degrees down); cable with plug runs down the column to the floor; front (light) = -Y; no text, no logo

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
